killedBy: validateProfileCatalogue refuses a catalogue that cannot mean what it says refuses an empty matcher, which would swallow every unknown pad
why: Lets a catalogue entry with NO criteria through validation. Such an entry matches the first pad it is offered, so every unrecognized device silently acquires that entry's layout -- which is issue #596's defect restored from the opposite direction, and worse than the original because it wears a profile id and looks deliberate in a trace. Refused at authoring time rather than branched on at runtime, on the same grounds as the entity catalogues in src/sim/.
